ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity (white) and 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous zones localized at the distal lobes; low-intensity (black) pixels dominate the central and medial regions with high-frequency white mottling concentrated at the pigmentation interfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) observed across the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch to the upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially clustered circular high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the lower-left dark region and scattered across the central-right dark zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the left and central fluke regions and dense calcified clusters on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grained, stippled pigmentation transition zone on the medial right lobe where white pixels bleed into the dark central region.
